description: Defines the OAuthClient entity class for ORM mapping, representing OAuth client data in the database.

classes.name: OAuthClient
classes.description: Entity class representing OAuth client data with properties like id, name, clientId, clientSecret, redirectUri, confidentiality, and enabled status.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the OAuth client.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the OAuth client.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the OAuth client.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the OAuth client.

methods.name: isConfidential
methods.description: Checks if the client is confidential.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the client is enabled.
